issue.title: Link and start existing tasks with solo @route:id and active-task ^route:id
issue.description: A capture item that is only `@route:block-id[#pomodoro][=<X>]` or `^route:block-id[#pomodoro][=<X>]` links an existing task into today's Pomodoro ledger (and optionally starts that session) atomically, and typing `^` in Bob CLI completion and Bob Mac Capture offers only In Progress and Next tasks, inserting the full `route:block-id` in one accept.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/active_task_link.md requests this work

issue.title: Solo Pomodoro-link grammar and atomic execution

DISCOVERED ISSUE: (from bob-cli-2k.land) The solo-link ledger step does not treat a deferred Task Link as the task's dedicated link. plan_pomodoro_link_ledger -> find_movable_task_links (src/native/capture_task_toggle.rs, blame 22abed47 = bob-cli-28.1) skips '[[T]]#' in the running Pomodoro, so '^route:id' appends a second '[[T]]' instead of reporting already_current. Repro on the close_worked_vault fixture (tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_close.rs; CAPTURE running with '\t- [[bob#^web-capture]]#' on line 10, BOB_NOW='2026-09-28 09:37:00'): 'bob capture --dry-run -- "^bob:web-capture=x"' prints 'linked into CAPTURE at line 5' and 'carries 3 links', so the placeholder carries web-capture twice. With bob-cli-2k's numbered close, the natural un-defer '^bob:web-capture=x3' now fails with 'tasks 2 and 3 both link [[bob#^web-capture]] but get different outcomes', and only '=x2,3' works. Expected: a '[[T]]#' (and '![[T]]') line under the destination counts as the existing link (already_current), keeping its number. Nothing is corrupted (the close is atomic, and the duplicate error writes nothing), but the ledger gets a duplicate carry.
